name: Insight
description: Highlights a random valid move on the board. Multiple castings in a row will highlight additional moves, or notify if all have been revealed.

name: Mana Surge
description: Doubles the amount of mana gained from matches for a short duration.

name: Create Burning Tile
description: Creates a special tile that deals fire damage to the enemy each turn.

name: Gust of Wind
description: Rotates all gems in the chosen row or column.

targeting.prompt: Select a gem, then an adjacent gem to choose the direction.

name: Quick Swap
description: Swaps two gems without needing to form a match.

targeting.prompt: Select any two gems to swap.

name: Empower Self
description: Temporarily increases your Vigor, reducing damage taken and slightly boosting Skull/Fist damage.

name: Minor Heal
description: Heals you for a small amount of HP.

name: Chaotic Shift
description: Destroys up to 3 random gems on the board, causing new gems to fall.

name: Shadow Strike
description: Deals a small amount of direct Umbral damage to the enemy.

name: Empower Weapon
description: Temporarily increases the damage dealt by Skull matches.

name: Create Weapon
description: Converts up to 3 random gems into Skull gems.

name: Sharpen Weapon
description: Increases the damage value of a single Skull gem on the board.

name: Convert Mana
description: Converts a small amount of one mana type to another.
